name: an entered-in-error invoice has target 0, so everything reverses through the same delta

expected.workings: The money is all still there -- eligibleBase = 100000, settleable = 100000 - 0 = 100000, collected = 100000 - 0 = 100000 -- and every one of those numbers is reported so the row can explain itself. But the invoice carries an entered_in_error mark, so DD12's target is 0 REGARDLESS of the ratio: targetBase = 0 and target = 0. delta = 0 - 10000 = -10000. This is the one branch in the base that is not arithmetic, and it is the branch that makes a whole bill undoable.
